question.text: A Rs. 50 lakh equity-heavy portfolio needs to be rebalanced to add Rs. 5 lakh debt. Fresh client contribution of Rs. 5 lakh arrives. Tax-efficient action:

answer.text: Allocate the full Rs. 5 lakh fresh contribution to debt

explanation.text: The Logic: Using fresh inflow for rebalancing avoids capital gains taxation. The Trap: Selling equity triggers tax and friction. Cross-Exam Context: Tax-aware rebalancing in X-A, X-B. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Time client top-ups with review cycles to execute rebalancing tax-efficiently.
